definitions.explanation: The legal rule by which, once a set period has passed, a crime can no longer be prosecuted or a right can no longer be claimed.

definitions.gloss: (colloquial) too long ago to matter any more
definitions.explanation: Said jokingly of a past misdeed or secret: so much time has passed that it can now be admitted without consequences.

examples.japanese: {時効|じこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}した→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The statute of limitations has run out.

examples.japanese: {殺人罪|さつじんざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時効|じこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The statute of limitations for murder was abolished.

examples.english: If a debt is not claimed for a certain period, it can become time-barred so that it no longer has to be repaid.

⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{時効|じこう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}った→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧だ。

examples.english: After ten years, your blunders from your student days are more or less ancient history.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時効|じこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧: the limitation period expires
- {時効|じこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: the limitation period is about to run out
- {時効|じこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the end of the limitation period
- {時効|じこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤廃|てっぱい}→撤廃：12911_teppai⟧: abolition of the statute of limitations

CULTURAL NOTE:
In 2010 Japan abolished the statute of limitations for murder and other crimes punishable by death, after campaigns by victims' families.
